about_page.title: Why we built Atlanta Passport.
about_page.intro: Atlanta Passport is an independent guide built by Atlanta locals who love this city. Ahead of the 2026 World Cup, millions of visitors will pass through the airport, the venue, and a chain hotel — and miss the city entirely. We exist to change that.
about_page.story_title: From a napkin sketch to a printed booklet.
about_page.story_p1: It started with a frustration: every World Cup host city builds infrastructure for visitors but loses the soul. Atlanta has too much character to be a stopover.
about_page.story_p2: So we partnered with neighborhood businesses, designers, and local writers to build a real guide — one printed booklet, one digital site, one stamp at a time.
about_page.value_local_desc: Every spot in the passport is independently owned and operated in Atlanta.
about_page.value_real_desc: We write our own descriptions. We visit every spot. We say what we think.
about_page.value_ind_desc: No FIFA, no official sponsors, no corporate gatekeeping. Just the city.
about_page.team_title: Atlanta locals who built this for our city.

beltline_page.subtitle: Help visitors experience the real Atlanta — one stop at a time.
beltline_page.intro: A neighborhood-driven Tourist Passport Program along a curated, bike-friendly route on the Atlanta Beltline. Visitors collect stamps at participating small businesses and redeem rewards for completed passports.
beltline_page.highlights_title: What makes this route worth your time.
beltline_page.offers_subtitle: Each participating business creates one signature offer — something memorable that gives passport holders a reason to come in.
beltline_page.what_you_get_p1: A featured listing on the Beltline route page, your business stamp in every printed passport, social posts on the Atlanta Passport channel, and direct foot traffic from passport holders.

partners_page.subtitle: We're curating a limited group of local restaurants, bars, shops, venues, and experiences for Atlanta Passport.
partners_page.limited_title: Only a few spots open per neighborhood and category.
partners_page.limited_subtitle: We curate by neighborhood and category to keep the passport balanced and useful for visitors. When a category is full in a neighborhood, applications close.
partners_page.tiers_subtitle: Four levels of exposure — from a simple listing to full neighborhood route sponsorship across the printed passport and the digital guide.
partners_page.tier_starter_desc: Be part of the route. Low-barrier visibility for spots that want foot traffic from exploring visitors.
partners_page.tier_featured_desc: Get seen before visitors arrive. Everything in Local Spot plus digital promotion and priority placement.
partners_page.tier_premier_desc: Tell your story. Everything in Featured plus a full-page feature in the printed and digital Passport.
partners_page.tier_route_desc: Own the experience. Premier-level visibility tied directly to a curated neighborhood route.
partners_page.step1_desc: Tell us about your business. We review every application by hand.
partners_page.step2_desc: We confirm fit by neighborhood and category, then send you the full kit.
partners_page.step3_desc: Photos, stamp design, and content go through our local design team.
partners_page.step4_desc: Printed booklets ship May 2026. Digital site goes live with you on it.
